hero.title: File storage in TON Storage
hero.sub: Upload, provider selection and storage tracking in TON Storage.

upload.hint: Drag files here or use the buttons below
upload.assembling: Assembling the bag — this takes a while
upload.tooLarge: The bag is too large — the limit is {{max}}, use TON Torrent.
upload.replaceNote: Picking a folder replaces the files already selected ({{count}}).
upload.oneFolder: A bag is either one folder or a set of files.
upload.tooMany: Too many files — a bag holds at most {{max}}.
upload.tooMany_one: {{count}} file selected — a bag holds at most {{max}}.
upload.tooMany_other: {{count}} files selected — a bag holds at most {{max}}.
upload.nothingToUpload: No readable files in the drop — pick them with the button instead.
upload.folderReadFailed: Couldn't read the folder completely — pick it with the button.
upload.duplicateNames: Matching file names: {{names}}. Rename and add them again.
upload.nameTooLong: File names too long — rename them: {{names}}.

catalog.limitShort: {{max}} providers already selected — that is the limit
catalog.declinedSummary_one: {{count}} of {{total}} declined — replace or unselect it.
catalog.declinedSummary_other: {{count}} of {{total}} declined — replace or unselect them.
catalog.spanHidden_one: {{count}} provider hidden — it doesn't prove storage every {{days}}.
catalog.spanHidden_other: {{count}} providers hidden — they don't prove storage every {{days}}.
catalog.notInCatalog: No such key in the catalog
catalog.keyLookupFailed: Couldn't reach the catalog — try again.
catalog.offCatalogFull: Not in the catalog: no rating and no check statuses

strategy.cheapNote: Lowest price among the reliable ones

table.statusHint: % of stored files accessible for download

period.floorNote: No shorter than the check period — {{days}} d.
period.payNote: Providers will start uploading files once payment is confirmed

done.deployed: Contract deployed — providers need time to download the files. The status is in the My files tab.

files.title: Storage contracts
files.emptyHint: Upload your first file to start
files.emptyUnpaid: Pay for a bag above to get a contract
files.removeNote: The uploaded files will be deleted.
files.withdrawNote: Storage stops and the remaining balance returns to your wallet.
files.topupUnknown: The contract can't be read — enter the amount in GRAM.
files.finishNote: Only one bag can wait for payment at a time.
files.topupOffline: Could not read the contract — try again later.
files.confirmationsHint: How many selected providers confirmed storage

filters.title: Filters
filters.proofNote: How often a provider proves it still stores the bag
filters.proofRare: You learn about a lost bag only at the next check — set the period to {{days}} days or less.

provider.title: Provider
provider.notChecked: This provider has not been checked yet

reason.101: The provider address was not found in the network
reason.102: The checker reported no result for this bag
reason.103: The check was skipped — too many failed in a row
reason.104: The connection did not open — the request never reached the provider
reason.201: Cannot ping the provider — it is offline or ports are closed
reason.202: The bag ID could not be decoded — the check never reached the provider
reason.203: The provider did not answer the ping — its bags were not checked this time
reason.301: The provider did not return the bag info
reason.302: The bag info from the provider is unreadable or describes a different bag
reason.401: The provider did not return the requested piece of the bag
reason.402: The proof from the provider could not be parsed
reason.403: The provider did not prove it stores the bag

errors.unauthorized: The session has ended — connect your wallet again.
errors.loginFailed: Could not connect the wallet — try again.
errors.offersFailed: Could not get offers from the providers.
errors.paymentFailed: The transaction was not confirmed — try again.
errors.paymentUnchecked: The network did not answer — retry the payment: no second contract is created.
errors.confirmTimeout: No confirmation arrived in time — if you signed the transaction, it will land and the list will refresh itself.
errors.notLinked: Payment went through, but the bag was not linked to the contract — retry linking.
errors.hasUnpaid: There is an unpaid bag — pay for it or delete it.
errors.uploadTooLarge: The upload exceeds the server limit.
errors.serverFull: Temporary storage is out of space — try again later.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests — wait a minute and try again.
errors.offersIncomplete: Some providers did not answer — try again or replace the silent ones.
errors.badNames: The server rejected the file names — shorten the longest paths.
errors.linkNotSaved: This browser could not remember the payment — keep the tab open until the contract is deployed.
errors.unpaidUnknown: Could not check for unpaid bags — try again.
errors.removeFailed: Failed to remove the bag — try again.

providers.unreadable: The contract cannot be read from the blockchain.
providers.recreateSummary_one: {{count}} provider will start its period from zero and take the full bounty — up to {{amount}}
providers.recreateSummary_other: {{count}} providers will start their period from zero and take the full bounty — up to {{amount}}
providers.recreateUnknown: The contract's bag is unreadable — couldn't check which providers will be recreated.

wizard.expired: Free storage is over — the files are deleted.
